Reactivating Your Accounts
Dear customer,
Greetings from ila family!
Thank you for visiting our Service Center to reactivate your relationship with us. We are happy to inform you that your request has been approved and we have reactivated your accounts. Please use our app to order your new debit card for use with your accounts.
If you need any assistance, please talk to us on 17123456 or write to us at support@ilabank.com
Open ila app
Bank ABC Tower, Head Office, P.O Box: 5698, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
This email and any files transmitted with it are confidential and intended solely for the use of the individual or entity to whom they are addressed. If you have received this email in error, please notify the system manager.
